subject: SparkBridge - AWS private offer / price adaptation request
messages:
From: Erin Torres <erin.torres@sparkbridge.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@sparkbridge.com
Date: 2026-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer request + discount for pilot

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. SparkBridge is ready to run a three-region pilot (US East, US West, EU-W) for our intelligent content pipeline. Procurement asked me to follow up with a request for a private offer on AWS Marketplace. We have the SOW attached.

High level ask:
- 12-month pilot with a 6-month paid commit (we'll convert to annual if results meet goals)
- Estimated consumption: ~$18k/month once ramped (projected first-year TCV ~$180k)
- Requesting a 30% off list discount on the marketplace private offer to align with our procurement mandates

We are co-selling with AWS partner team and would prefer the private offer route so we can handle Consolidated Billing. Can you confirm whether that discount is possible, and what approvals you need? Also please include any carrier for co-sell paperwork or expedited signing cadence.

Attaching: SparkBridge_SOW_v1.pdf

Cheers,
Erin Torres
Head of Platform
SparkBridge
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: 2026-10-07T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer request + discount for pilot

Team — forwarding SparkBridge's request. Key points: 12mo pilot, 6mo paid commit, ~$18k/mo runrate, external ask = 30% marketplace private-offer discount. They are an SMB with strong channel backing from AWS; AWS partner rep is on the thread (cc'd).

Questions for Deal Desk / Finance:
- Is 30% within our marketplace concession guardrails for a first-year committed pilot?
- If not, what tiered structure (onboarding credit + year-1 discount) can we offer to keep the deal within margin targets?
- Any AWS private-offer restrictions we should flag (co-sell SKUs, listing minimums)?

Attached the SOW and a draft private-offer PDF that the partner started. Please advise next steps and I'll loop in the partner and procurement to finalize.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, West
Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: aws-partner@amazon.com, erin.torres@sparkbridge.com
Date: 2026-10-08T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer request + discount for pilot

Thanks for the context, Karthik. Quick take from GTM/Marketplace side: 30% is at the high end for a first-year SMB private offer; typical approved ranges are 15-25% depending on committed ARR and co-sell incentives. Given the partner is involved, we can be flexible but will need a finance memo and AWS partner confirmation of co-sell contribution.

Proposed structure to start internal approvals:
- Onboarding credit: 20% of first-month invoiced amount (one-time)
- Year-1 private-offer discount: 25% off list, with standard overage pricing thereafter
- Convert-to-annual bonus: additional 5% credit if they convert to a 12-month prepaid within 90 days of pilot completion

Please add: margin expectation for this seat (vanessa/markus) and any legal SOW changes. I'll prepare the marketplace intake and notify the AWS partner for private-offer issuance. Link to intake form: https://redwood.internal/marketplace-intake (internal only).

-Stephanie
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: erin.torres@sparkbridge.com, procurement@sparkbridge.com
Date: 2026-10-09T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer request + discount for pilot (approved with conditions)

Karthik / team — reviewed SparkBridge's requested economics and the proposed structure from Stephanie. Finance can approve a one-time onboarding credit + a tiered discount capped at 25% for Year 1 under the following conditions:

1) Customer signs the attached SOW (no material change to deliverables) and provides evidence of the 6-month paid commit.
2) AWS private-offer must be created and accepted within 21 days; Redwood will not backdate credits beyond acceptance date.
3) We require a brief internal approval memo signed by GTM and Finance (attached: approved_discount_memo.pdf).
4) If consumption exceeds forecast by >40% in a month, standard overage rates apply (no retroactive discount).

I am comfortable approving: onboarding credit = 20% of month-1 invoice; Year-1 marketplace discount = 25% on committed volume. If they push for 30%, we can offer an additional 5% as a one-time rebate, payable after 6 months contingent on meeting agreed usage milestones (we'll document in SOW amendment).

Please prepare the private-offer draft and get procurement to countersign. Finance will release the memo once legal confirms SOW alignment.

-Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Erin Torres <erin.torres@sparkbridge.com>, procurement@sparkbridge.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, aws-partner@amazon.com
Date: 2026-10-12T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Private offer and next steps (SparkBridge)

Erin — great to move this forward. Per internal approvals, here is our offered structure for the private offer:

- Onboarding credit: 20% of month-1 invoice (applied as a credit on first invoice)
- Year-1 committed discount: 25% off list for committed monthly volume (as reflected in the private offer)
- Additional 5% rebate: contingent payment after 6 months if usage meets the milestone defined in the attached SOW amendment
- Acceptance window: private offer must be accepted within 21 days of issuance

Attachments: Marketplace_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf, approved_discount_memo.pdf
Private offer link (AWS): https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/private-offers/12345

Next steps for SparkBridge / Procurement:
1) Review attached private-offer draft and SOW amendment.
2) If agreeable, accept the private offer in AWS Marketplace and countersign the SOW in DocuSign.
3) Notify us with the acceptance confirmation; we'll schedule onboarding and apply the onboarding credit to the first invoice.

If you want to push for a higher upfront discount (the 30% ask), we can structure a 5% post-facto rebate tied to the 6-month milestone (as Markus notes) — tell me if you'd prefer that route and we'll include the language in the SOW amendment.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looping AWS partner in to help expedite private-offer issuance.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
